Keywise Capital Management LTD Boosted Its Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg LTD (TSM) Stake by $752,500; As Alexander & Baldwin (ALEX) Market Valuation Declined, Shareholder Stevens First Principles Investment Advisors Upped Holding
June 10, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Fang Zheng increased its stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd (TSM) by 21.71% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Keywise Capital Management Ltd bought 17,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.51% with the market. The hedge fund run by Fang Zheng held 98,100 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $4.29 million, up from 80,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Keywise Capital Management Ltd who had been investing in Taiwan Semiconductor Mfg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $197.38B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.49% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $38.93. About 8.08M shares traded or 7.30% up from the average. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 10.49% since June 10, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.08% the S&P500.
